```bash
# 查看配置
ls /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/configs/config_*sonnet*n17* /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/configs/config_*claude*n17* 2>/dev/null

# 或查看 bash history

```

```bash

```
